title: Phase 2 Second Review & v10.0 Protocol Re-Audit — Admin Console, Settings & Security (Re-evaluating DIR-012, DIR-015, DIR-016, DIR-017)
spec:
# Phase 2 Second Review Directive: Admin Console, Settings & Security (DIR-032)
**Governing Protocol:** SKILL.md v10.0 (AI Bridge Supervisor Master Edition)
**Execution Schedule:** Sequenced in the Post-DIR-028 Second Review Pipeline.
**Target Directives for Re-Audit:** DIR-012, DIR-015, DIR-016, DIR-017.

## 1. Objective & Scope
Re-evaluate Platform Admin Console, SuperAdmin Settings, Security Command Center, and Cross-Portal Navigation Completeness against v10.0 rules.

## 2. Mandatory Verification Gates
1. **§24 Zero Secret Leakage:** Proof that API keys are strictly server-side.
2. **§24 RBAC & Negative Auth:** Verify 401/403 guards across all sensitive administrative endpoints.
3. **§24 TOTP MFA & Session Revocation:** Live MariaDB verification.
4. **§21.1 Design Tokens:** Admin tree navigation and settings controls adhere to Cuba tokens.
invariants: INV-1: Zero Plaintext Secret Leakage: NVIDIA, Gemini, OpenAI, Groq, and OpenRouter API keys must never be returned in API payloads, browser localStorage, or DOM.
INV-2: Multi-Tenant Authorization & RBAC: SuperAdmin role simulator, system settings, and candidate security centers must enforce strict RBAC and negative authorization guards.
acceptanceCriteria: §24 Security Audit & Secret Scanner: Automated scan proving zero unmasked API keys in client-accessible assets; negative authorization test proving unauthorized users receive HTTP 401/403 on /api/admin/*.
§24 Account & Security Command Center: TOTP MFA enrollment, active session revocation, and security audit log tested against live MariaDB.
§21.1 Admin Console & SuperAdmin Settings Token Audit: Cuba executive tree navigation, SWOT configuration panels, and platform provisioner tabs use 100% Cuba design tokens.
§16 Navigation Completeness: Verify Enterprise Platform Provisioner tab and Candidate Favorites restoration remain 100% operational with 0 regression.
